content: Bulk selection conventions (PatternFly, HashiCorp Helios, SaaS UI, NN/g): tri-state header checkbox = select current page; explicit 'select all N across all pages' link when dataset spans pages; selection must survive pagination or be explicitly scoped; contextual action bar appears after selection showing count + actions; destructive bulk needs confirm dialog with exact count; NN/g prefers undo over confirmation for non-destructive; clear selection after action.
